title: AION 2 Spacetime Rift Guide: Timers, Entry, and Safe Routes
description: Plan an AION 2 Spacetime Rift visit by checking region, opening and entry timers, map height, PvP flags, guards, revival, and exploration objectives.
summary: Separate opening time, entrance window, and stay duration. Check your region's live rules, then prepare a focused exploration or PvP route with a return plan.

topic.alt: Official AION 2 artwork of the Elyos world
topic.caption: Official Elyos world artwork for the cross-faction exploration context. It is not a map of rift entrances or proof of their current locations.

workflow.title: Separate entry timing from time inside
workflow.caption: Use the current client for each field. Older regional reports and third-party timers are comparison aids, not a fixed Global schedule.

steps.label: Confirm region and timezone
steps.description: Match the timer to your region and read its timezone before setting a reminder.

steps.label: Reach the active entrance
steps.description: Use the current marker and entry warning; record when the entrance accepts players and when it closes.

steps.label: Check remaining stay
steps.description: After crossing, read the separate time inside and choose one nearby objective plus a return route.

steps.label: Return on your own plan
steps.description: Leave room for movement and danger. Read the revival destination before accepting a death option.
